summary: ARKO Petroleum Corp. (acquirer) filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement dated August 4, 2026, to buy the vertically integrated fuel supply and distribution platform of U.S. Petroleum Partners, LLC (Seller) for the Great Lakes region. Consideration: $205.0 million cash plus inventory value at closing and $30.0 million in Class A common stock (Consideration Shares) held in escrow until a True-Up Date, contingent on EBITDA targets over a 12-month period. The acquired business includes two fuel terminals connected to Buckeye Pipeline, supply rights to 400+ dealer locations, and a transport fleet. No advisors named; regulatory clock and closing conditions not detailed. Watch for deal closing and earn-out achievement.
